title: Word ladder length
statementMd:
Transform `begin` into `end` changing one letter at a time, where every intermediate word must be in `words`. Return the number of words in the shortest sequence (including begin and end), or 0 if impossible.

**Example:** `ladder_length("hit", "cog", ["hot", "dot", "dog", "lot", "log", "cog"])` returns `5`.
hints: BFS over words differing by one letter.
